audit.why: Win rate 52.32% over 1617 games (Renata favored overall) is consistent with the content narrative even though Nautilus wins 5 of 7 chart rows -- Renata's lane-1 and late-game/teamfight R swing back and outweigh Nautilus's mid-lane CC-chain advantage in the aggregate win rate. The packet's own defect note flags this tension as worth a human look, recorded in notes rather than 'fixed' since nothing in the kit tells me which layer (winrate vs chart) is wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0..6].side were all the placeholder 'Skill' while content win[] already reads Renata, Nautilus, Nautilus, Nautilus, Nautilus, Nautilus, Renata.
audit.why: win[] is already correct and grounded (Nautilus's point-and-click hook-passive-shield chain locks Renata's single-root kit from level 2 through first item; Renata's R counter-engage flips it late). Only the full-layer side and generic why needed fixing to match.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0].side and phases[6].side to 'Renata', phases[1-5].side to 'Nautilus', and replaced the boilerplate why text (identical across other matchups) with Nautilus-specific reasoning.

notes: Full-layer level chart carried the placeholder 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content win[] already had the real Renata/Nautilus split -- fixed side to match and rewrote the boilerplate why text with Nautilus-specific reasoning. Packet flags the aggregate 52.32% Renata win rate as being in tension with a chart that gives Nautilus 5 of 7 rows -- left as-is since the content layer's own narrative (early Renata lane, mid Nautilus lockdown, late Renata R flip) is internally consistent and plausibly explains a slight overall Renata edge without the row-level chart being wrong; flagging for a human to double check against real data if they want a second opinion. Two 'terrain' kit-flag misfires found but not acted on: Nautilus's Q (Dredge Line) is flagged 'creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' in the kit file, but Riot's own description says Q only pulls Nautilus toward terrain he hits, not that it creates a wall -- the _missing-interactions suggestion built on that flag ('hold Flash for the wall') was correctly NOT added to the page since it doesn't match the ability's real behavior. Also left alone as unverified (not newly written, pre-existing text): spikes[Lvl6] and late/whys claim Renata's R 'fears' Nautilus and 'negates' Depth Charge -- Renata's kit file has no flag confirming R is fear-type CC that interrupts an in-progress Depth Charge; recording as unverified rather than asserting further.
